name: StableDomains

overview.text: StableDomains presents domain registration and management paid with USDC, USDT or card, with guest checkout, API/MCP/x402 access and WHOIS privacy where the registry permits. It advertises 435 endings and first-year prices from $2.79. Sample .com pricing is $16.99 initially and on renewal; .icu is $2.79 initially and $39.19 on renewal. These are examples, not an available-name quote or final total, and card payment adds a fee. The described flow locks a quote for 60 minutes and starts registration after payment confirms; registration also creates renewal obligations.

disclosure: Disclosure: suggested for the Atlas by the operator, Tim Johnson (StableDomains), in an email to Commonworld on 2026-10-29. No payment, deal or paid placement is involved, and the card does not depend on one.
